name: Mindfulness Coach
one_liner: Mindfulness Coach is a free, self-guided mindfulness training program from the VA with audio exercises and progress tracking.
best_for: Beginners who want a structured, free mindfulness course
short_description: Mindfulness Coach is a free, self-guided mindfulness training program from the VA with audio exercises and progress tracking.
long_description: Mindfulness Coach is a free, self-guided mindfulness training program from the VA with audio exercises and progress tracking. A gradual course in mindfulness: short readings, 12 guided audio exercises (more free to download), goals and reminders. Made by the VA's National Center for PTSD; free with no in-app purchases. What it includes: Progressive mindfulness program; 12 guided audio exercises; Goals and reminders; Mastery self-assessment.

faqs.q: How much does Mindfulness Coach cost?
faqs.a: Free. Prices were checked in October 2026 and can change, so confirm with Mindfulness Coach before you sign up.

faqs.q: Can Mindfulness Coach replace therapy or treatment?
faqs.a: No. Mindfulness Coach is a self-help tool that can support your wellbeing or work alongside therapy, but it doesn't diagnose or treat conditions. If you're in crisis, call or text 988 in the US.

faqs.q: Where can I use Mindfulness Coach?
faqs.a: Mindfulness Coach is available on iPhone and Android.
